name: VP Plaza España Design
description: VP Plaza España Design 5* has 214 rooms that are characterized by their large size, exclusive views and comfort. There are up to 9 different types of room to suit the tastes and demands of each customer. Some rooms have a balcony, others have a separate dressing room and some even have a private gym. The most spectacular suite is distinguished by its 120m2. The 'Design' philosophy is also perceived in the commitment to art, as paintings of great taste from recognized prestigious artists decorate the walls of each room and common areas.
